_doc: Versioned model-normalization seed (M3 Task 1) — the embedded source
of truth mirrored into the model_map table at store open. Raw model
strings stay immutable forever; only the derived model_family column
uses this map. Unknown models pass through with model_family = model
(CLAUDE.md: never normalize by guessing) — that covers live-only
strings like slash-named models (nvidia/...) until they earn entries.
Editing this file: bump map_version on ANY change to families.
Historical model_family values change ONLY via
`tatitok recompute --model-map` (explicit, logged, AS-4); ingest
stamps new events under the current version.
Entry notes:
- <synthetic>: claude-code synthetic records are excluded by the
adapter today (oracle-matching), so this entry is defensive — if a
format change ever lets one through, it lands in family 'synthetic'.
- deepseek-v4-flash-free: '-free' is a gateway billing tier of the
same model, so it folds into the base family; pricing resolves the
RAW model string first, so the $0 tier is not lost (Task 2).
- qwen3.6-35b-nvfp4-tecnigmaai: nvfp4 quantization + org recipe are
serving detail, preserved verbatim in the raw model column; the
family strips them. The a3b variant is a distinct architecture and
keeps its own family.
- gx10: owner-configured alias of a local serving box; the underlying
model is not derivable from the string, so the family is the alias
itself (identity, but recorded as a reviewed decision, not an
unknown passthrough).
